summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine open-market share buyback conducted under its existing £1.75 billion buyback programme. On 29 May 2026, the company purchased 7,853,706 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International at a volume-weighted average price of 101.6482 pence per share (range 101.0–102.2 pence). These shares will be cancelled, reducing outstanding equity. The buyback is part of a programme announced 30 January 2026; cumulative purchases total 1,070,430,900 shares for £1,044,270,224. No board recommendation or advisor is named because this is an issuer capital return, not a tender. Watch for continued execution pace and potential impact on EPS and capital ratios.
